source_snapshot.procedure: Direct-connect SUT/client, install NIC drivers, assign IPs and run SST network stress for 12 hours.

original_test_intent: Verify every applicable PCIe slot/NIC path sustains 12-hour network stress at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails with throughput above the approved 80% bandwidth baseline and no link or platform errors.
original_method: Map every applicable physical slot to NIC serial/BDF/netdev/root port, lane capability and peer path; establish dry-chamber/dew-point controls and soak at 0C before applying approved +5% rails; verify negotiated links and run a pinned finite SST profile for 12 hours per the approved simultaneous/sequential coverage; record per-path throughput/utilization/errors, AER/link events, rail and temperature data; warm above dew point before opening the chamber and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator installs/routes NICs, controls dry chamber and rails, supervises the 12-hour run and performs safe warm-up/restoration.
required_inputs: Per-slot link/AER/error/thermal abort and warm-up plan
safety_requirements: Control humidity and dew point before cooling
Do not open chamber or handle hardware while condensation risk exists
Use calibrated rail measurement and prevent overshoot
Preserve logs; abort on link/AER/electrical/thermal instability
Warm and dry before restoring hardware access
agent_execution_scope: May validate mappings and analyze per-slot throughput and health artifacts
Must not control chamber/rails or move cards/cables and must not decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve slot matrix, traffic baseline and environmental profile
Review each slot and determine verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote-only margin execution, but generic network stress does not prove every physical slot without an identity matrix.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the approved SST profile against each mapped NIC path only after cold-soak, dew-point and high-rail stability are verified.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Every PCIe slot, network stress, 12 hours, 0C, +5% 5V/3.3V and >80% throughput are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use per-slot traffic results correlated with root-port AER/link telemetry and continuous dew-point/rail data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable slot identity, bandwidth calculation, condensation prevention, per-path evidence and controlled warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One NIC path or aggregate throughput cannot prove every PCIe slot; nominal-temperature evidence cannot substitute for cold/high-rail behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Low temperature and elevated rails may affect link training; warming/opening without dew-point control risks condensation damage unrelated to the intended test.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines applicable slots, card-move versus fully populated coverage, per-path or aggregate 80% threshold, link-speed allowance and chamber humidity policy.
expected_evidence: Per-slot/path throughput statistic, utilization, errors and link resets
Safe warm-up, restored topology and nominal post-health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and criteria align on every-slot network stress under cold/high-rail margin; the exact slot matrix remains an engineering input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The coverage and acceptance direction are clear; physical execution requires approved topology, baseline and environmental controls.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row34 Wistron-Margin-00033-V002: approve applicable PCIe slot-to-NIC/BDF/netdev/root-port/lane and peer/IP/cable map, SST/driver profile and simultaneous/sequential 12-hour coverage, per-path 80%-bandwidth formula/statistic, 0C humidity/dew-point/+5% rail tolerances, link/AER/thermal abort and safe warm-up/restoration.

review_improvement: Makes 'all PCIe slots' attributable per physical path and adds the cold-environment condensation controls needed for safe, credible evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The network workload validates PCIe slots only if each NIC-to-slot/root-port mapping and negotiated link are recorded. At 0C, both link training and condensation risk are distinct concerns; throughput alone cannot distinguish a cold PCIe degradation from peer or network configuration effects.
